A musharaka pool distributes profit strictly according to the pre-agreed profit-sharing ratios stipulated in the contract, regardless of capital contribution proportions, while losses are shared strictly in proportion to each partner's invested capital.
A provenance ledger creates an immutable, chronological record documenting the origin, custody, transfers, and processing history of an asset or data object to verify its authenticity and integrity.
Preregistration prevents drift by locking the analysis plan before data access, eliminating post-hoc flexibility to cherry-pick outcomes or methods.
Comparator absence is the lack of a control group or benchmark intervention against which to measure the effect of a treatment or policy.
